works.author: Permadi Satria Dewanto for Plainthing Studio
works.comment: 科研管理 SaaS 落地页 Meadow：大标题“Read, check, and cite with confidence.”，上方 New Study 面板里“答案要标明出处”配粉色花卉图与细线手稿插画，下方 Northfield Lab、papercut 等机构背书；学术工具用“花卉柔美视觉 + 逐句可查的引用承诺”把严谨做得不冷硬。
works.comment_en: Meadow, a research-management SaaS landing page: the headline "Read, check, and cite with confidence." sits under a New Study panel promising answers that cite their sources, softened by pink floral photography and fine-line hand illustrations, with Northfield Lab and papercut as backers; an academic tool makes rigor feel warm by pairing floral softness with a checkable-citation promise.
works.title: Meadow — Saas Research Management Website Design

works.author: Mahmudul Hasan Manik for Panze - UX Design Studio
works.comment: 海湾电子发票 SaaS 仪表盘 Rabt：左侧栏按沙特与阿联酋分开列出发票、EGS 单元与集成，右屏一句“Good morning, Al Noor Trading Co.”配 98.7% 三十天接受率；合规工具用“国家分栏 + 一句问候 + 一个接受率”把枯燥的报税讲得有人味。
works.comment_en: Rabt, a Gulf e-invoicing SaaS dashboard: the sidebar splits Saudi and UAE e-invoicing, invoices and EGS units by country, while the main view greets "Good morning, Al Noor Trading Co." beside a 98.7% thirty-day acceptance rate; a compliance tool makes tax filing human with country-split navigation, a greeting, and one acceptance number.
works.title: Rabt - ERP & POS to Gulf E-Invoicing SaaS Dashboard UI UX Design

works.author: Imran Hossen
works.comment: AI 视频平台 Lumora 注册页：左半边雨夜路灯下红衣女子旋转的电影感剧照，配“From prompt to premiere in under two minutes.”的评价，右半边“Create your studio”注册表单，Google / Apple 一键登录、200 免费额度；注册页用“一帧电影剧照 + 一句两分钟成片”先把产品能力演出来。
works.comment_en: Lumora, an AI video platform signup page: the left half is a cinematic still of a woman in red spinning under a rainy street lamp, captioned "From prompt to premiere in under two minutes.", while the right half holds a "Create your studio" form with Google and Apple sign-in and 200 free credits; the signup sells the product by showing one film frame before asking for an email.
works.title: Lumora — Sign up to first film, no friction | AI Video Platform

works.author: Topnotch UI/UX for Topnotch Studio
works.comment: AI 语音平台 Voxora 官网：紫色渐变底上大标题“Every voice you'll ever need in one AI platform”，中央声波纹配圆形播放钮，下方 Text to Speech 与 Voice Cloning 两大功能并排；语音产品用“一条声波 + 两个功能入口”一次讲清能做什么。
works.comment_en: Voxora AI voice platform site: a purple gradient carries the headline "Every voice you'll ever need in one AI platform" above a waveform with a round play button, with Text to Speech and Voice Cloning side by side below; a voice product explains itself with one waveform and two feature doors.
works.title: AI Voice Platform Webflow Design

works.author: Azmir Sheikh
works.comment: AI 销售意向仪表盘 Reachly Signals：摆在金属框架显示器里的 Signals 页，Hiring Shifts 42、Raised Funding 31、New VP Sales 26、Website visits 64、Competitor followers 18 六张小卡片垫底，右侧 Live signal stream 实时滚动，底部 Top accounts by intent 排开；销售信号用“六张意向卡 + 一条实时流”让先找谁一目了然。
works.comment_en: Reachly's AI sales-intent dashboard, Signals: a monitor in a chrome frame shows six small cards — Hiring Shifts 42, Raised Funding 31, New VP Sales 26, Website visits 64, Competitor followers 18 — with a live signal stream scrolling on the right and Top accounts by intent below; buying signals read as six intent cards plus one live feed, so you know whom to call first.
works.title: AI SDR Sales Intent Dashboard | B2B SaaS UIUX Design

works.author: Mahid
works.comment: AI SaaS 落地页 Aster：紫底上一只戴黑手套的手托着手机，屏上大标题“Every conversation, one clear decision”，下方 Theme Explorer 列着 Onboarding friction 1,123 次提及等主题统计；移动端落地页用“一只手托起产品 + 一句结论先行”把分析工具讲得有冲击力。
works.comment_en: Aster AI SaaS landing page: a gloved hand holds a phone against a purple backdrop, its screen reading "Every conversation, one clear decision" above a Theme Explorer counting mentions like Onboarding friction at 1,123; a mobile landing page lands its punch with one hand holding the product and one conclusions-first headline.
works.title: AI SaaS Landing Page Design

works.author: Purrweb UI/UX Agency
works.comment: 客户成功软件 Web App：深紫底上“$412K AT RISK”大字镇场，7 天内到期续约，Acme Corp $48K、Northwind Labs $77K、Globex $31K 等 12 个账号按金额排开，右侧 Win-Back 面板配挽回负责人；续约风险用“一个总金额 + 一张按天排开的账号清单”让客户成功经理先救最贵的。
works.comment_en: Customer success web app: a dark purple view leads with "$412K AT RISK" and seven days to renewal, listing 12 accounts by value — Acme Corp $48K, Northwind Labs $77K, Globex $31K — with a Win-Back panel and owners on the right; renewal risk reads as one total plus a day-by-day account list, so the CSM saves the biggest accounts first.
works.title: Customer Success Software Web App Design

works.author: Ronas IT | UI/UX Team
works.comment: 租房 App 三屏并列：左屏 $829/月、45m²、2 室 1 卫的曼哈顿中城房源配房东联系按钮，中屏“Find a place you'll love.”大标题配客厅实拍，右屏 Filters 里租期、$320–$2,354 价格滑杆、房型与卧室数；找房流程用“房源卡 + 情感标题 + 筛选器”三屏一次讲完。
works.comment_en: Home rental app in three phones: a $829/month, 45m², two-bed Midtown Manhattan listing with a Contact landlord button; a "Find a place you'll love." hero over a living-room photo; and a Filters screen with rental period, a $320–$2,354 price slider, property type and bedrooms; the search flow fits in three screens — listing, feeling, filters.
works.title: Real Estate Dashboard - Home Rental App

works.author: Sk Raju Hossin
works.comment: 创作者与社区仪表盘 Orbit Ring Explore：笔记本屏上左侧深色导航，中间“Slow Living Week”精选挑战配 #CityWalks、#SelfCare 话题卡，右侧 Rising Creators 与 Mindful Makers、Design Nights 等社区；社区产品用“一个精选挑战 + 话题卡 + 创作者榜”把发现页做成逛街的感觉。
works.comment_en: Orbit Ring's Explore creators and community dashboard: a laptop view with dark left navigation, a featured "Slow Living Week" challenge beside #CityWalks and #SelfCare topic cards, and Rising Creators plus communities like Mindful Makers and Design Nights on the right; a community product turns discovery into window-shopping with one featured challenge, topic cards and a creator list.
works.title: Explore, Creators & Community Dashboard UI

works.author: NexUX Product for Nexux Lab
works.comment: 按需配送 App 三屏：左屏骑手跨上踏板车“Delivered Fresh To Your Doorstep”，中屏 Set Pickup Point、Product / Food / Medicine 分类与 DHL Express、FedEx 承运商，右屏地图实时追踪配 Elizabeth Mary 配送员与 Live Tracking 按钮；配送 App 用“骑手海报 + 下单页 + 实时地图”三步把从下单到送达讲全。
works.comment_en: On-demand delivery app in three phones: a courier swinging onto a scooter under "Delivered Fresh To Your Doorstep", a Set Pickup Point screen with Product, Food and Medicine categories and DHL Express and FedEx carriers, and a live-tracking map with courier Elizabeth Mary and a Live Tracking button; delivery reads as three steps — poster, order, live map.
works.title: On-Demand Delivery Mobile App
